parrafo_1.es: Touch del Sol es el estudio de masajes y bodywork de Natasha, dentro de Sixth Street Wellness Center en Gainesville. Trabaja con masaje thai, terapia craneosacral biodinámica y bodywork profundo e intencional, ajustando presión y enfoque a lo que cada cuerpo realmente necesita.
parrafo_1.en: Touch del Sol is Natasha's massage and bodywork studio inside Sixth Street Wellness Center in Gainesville. She works with Thai massage, craniosacral biodynamic therapy and deep, intentional bodywork, matching her pressure and approach to what each body actually needs.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas vuelven por años: Jaclyn lleva más de cinco siendo su clienta y sigue describiendo cada sesión como 'una experiencia positiva y sanadora'. Touch del Sol es un negocio dirigido por una mujer latina, y se identifica como LGBTQ+ y LGBTQ+ friendly.
parrafo_2.en: Her clients keep coming back for years: Jaclyn has been seeing her for over five years and still calls every session 'a positive and healing experience.' Touch del Sol is women-owned and Latino-owned, identifies as LGBTQ+ owned, and is LGBTQ+ friendly.

items.quote: I have been seeing Natasha for over 5 years now and I always tell people she is truly incredible! I dealt with major back, foot and shoulder issues and seeing Natasha has made them very manageable. I feel like her hands were blessed because she truly has helped to heal me! It's always a positive and healing experience when I see her. Cannot recommend enough!

I've had massages regularly in the past, but never one like this. Natasha combines her gifts and her knowledge to transport you to a place of relaxation, peace and healing. I immediately felt comfortable and at home in her cozy space. She's professional, extremely skilled at reading the body, and is intentional in her practice.
Natasha did a phenomenal job on my shoulder, which has been suffering from repetitive stress issues. So relaxing, calming and magical, for the first time in months I slept without shoulder pain.
